question.text: Within how many working days from the expiry of the buyback period must the merchant banker submit the final report to SEBI?

explanation.text: The Logic: The merchant banker must file a final report with SEBI within 15 working days from the date of expiry of the buyback period, in electronic mode. The Trap: 7 working days is too short and is not the correct timeline. 21 working days may seem reasonable but is also incorrect. The exact regulatory requirement is 15 working days. Cross-Exam Context: NISM Series IX tests various reporting timelines for merchant bankers; similar post-completion reporting requirements exist for takeovers.
